predictions: Oh, no, dude… the trend has continued. This is looking awful. My four records in the first four weeks, in order, are: 18-8, 17-9, 16-10, and now 15-11. Somehow I know less and less about you guys with every passing week. Shouldn't this be going the other way?? Obviously, this brings my record for the season to 66-38 (63.5% correct), which is barely passable. And I STILL haven't gotten a match pick correct with either Main Street Mayhem or the Dart Bags… inconceivable!

Match of the week: (F Div.) Nein Mark @ Heart of Dartness. Oh, baby, here we go!!! F division has two undefeated teams that already have a two-match (or greater) lead on everybody else. And here they are squaring off!! This is the drama we all love (both to see and of which to be a part). But…. how is Dartness in this spot with a losing SCkt record (and a barely winning DCkt record)? I'll go Nein, 14-10.

Match #2: (D Div.) Bottoms Up @ Main Street Mayhem. Something has to give here, right? I said that I was going to keep picking the Bottoms, and I was going to keep being right. But if I do and I am, then I actually get a Mayhem pick right (gasp!). I did say I was riding the Bottoms Up train until the wheels fell off so… Bottoms Up, 15-9.

Match #3: (B Div.) Hump Day! @ Darty Little Secrets. The top three teams in B have all already had a bye, so their leader records are only 3-0, 2-1, 2-1. That sure leaves a LOT of room for comebacks by other teams, no? Especially since they are going to be picking each other off at times… like in this one. The Humpers open some space, 15-9.

Match #4: (C Div.) Mulligan's Mafia @ Pints & Points. The Possee sits undefeated in C, alone at the top. But these two are the only pair at 3-1, so the winner here is immediately the Possee's prime season title competition alone. These teams feel super even, so I really do feel like I'm guessing here. That said, I'm guessing… Mafia, 13-11.

Match #5: (G Div.) She-nanigans @ 21 Dart Salute. Flight Club got their shot at Salute last week, and now it's the She-nanigans' turn. But geez, if the DCkt-monster Flight Club can't get past Salute, how the heck will the other teams do it? That means this is Salute, 14-10.

Match #6: (E Div.) Dart Knights @ Runs with Corks. Oh, ouch, both of these teams took one on the chin last week. But somehow, they are the only 2-2 teams in the division, so the winner here is instantly at #3 all alone. That's a decently powerful position. Corks, 13-11?

Match #7: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Duck Fook. Half of the D teams are 2-2, and the lone 3-1 team has to face the leader of the division tonight. Could the winner here all of a sudden move all the way up to 2nd? I don't think so, because I'm taking Menace, 13-11.

Match #8: (C Div.) Rif Raf @ One Armed Bandits. For the last time this season, we have a match that is guaranteed to produce a first- time winner. Maybe this could be the start of a streak that we will be talking about for years. And that story will be… Rif Raf's! 13-11.

Match #9: (B Div.) Wing & a Plaque @ Dart Attack. All that stuff I wrote about match #3? Well, here is the other of the lead trio, and they're facing the #4 team with a great point total. This is almost as big as match #3… This is going to be super tense. Wing wins 1001.

Match #10: (G Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ Shark Shooters. This pair sits at 2-2, facing a pivot point. Win and make a charge at the leaders, or lose and drop to the bottom half? I'll go Shooters, 14-10.
Match #11: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Aim For Fame. These teams are mere points from last place. And simultaneously barely more than one win from third place. !?!? Let's take the Famous, 13-11.
Match #12: (C Div.) Liquor Possee @ Shooter McGavin. Liquor Possee leads, but has some potential land mines in their road. They will take this one, but they better pay attention here. Possee, 14-10.
